Job Training – COVID-19 Grants & Other Resources
• COVID-19 Dislocated Worker Grant $12 million to Texas Workforce 
Commission (TWC)
• States may sub-grant funds to local boards and/or expend funds through public/private 
agencies
• Allowable activities: disaster relief employment, employment and training services and 
supportive services
• Workforce Solutions for Tarrant County

• Adult Education

Medical Clinics – CARES Act Funds
• CARES Act Provider Relief Fund providing additional funds to Medicaid 
and CHIP Providers
• Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) Enhanced Provider Relief 
Fund Portal
• Payment will be at least 2% of reported gross revenue from patient care
• According to the CDC HHS Provider Relief Fund dataset, $40,862,483 has been 
provided to 249 Arlington healthcare providers as of June 17th
• Webcast today June 23 and Thursday June 25 to learn more about the 
application process
• HRSA CARES Act – $1.3 billion
• HRSA Coronavirus Preparedness and Response Supplemental Funding
2. CDBG-CV Status
• Arlington received $2,004,017 in CARES Act CDBG-CV to focus on activities 
that prevent, prepare for, and respond to COVID-19.
• On June 9, the CND Committee discussed the following funding categories for 
CDBG-CV funds:
• Emergency Rental Assistance: $800,000
• Non-Profit COVID-19 Services: $457,661
• Administration/Compliance: $346,356
• To Be Determined $400,000
• Today’s meeting will focus on follow-up recommendations and next steps for 
the use of $400,000
Child Care Needs
• During the declaration of emergency related to COVID-19, many child 
care centers were closed or required to serve only children of 
essential workers
• Child care providers lost significant revenue and many are still closed 
or at reduced capacity
• As businesses open up in Arlington, there is an increased need for 
affordable and available child care slots to help families restore and 
maintain income
• At the last committee meeting, members discussed using available 
CDBG-CV funds to support child care services
Child Care Survey
• Child Care Associates (CCA) has been collecting data from child care providers in Tarrant 
County.  The following is survey data from June 8.
• Of 415 sites reporting, 103 were from Arlington (25%)
• Of 9,879 child care slots, 2,276 were from Arlington (23%)
• In Tarrant County, 67% of child care providers were open and 33% closed due to COVID-19
• In Arlington, 74% of providers were open and 26% were closed, representing about 592 
child care slots closed due to COVID-19
• More centers are opening each week

• Full Council review on August 18
